title: The Antique Microwave Oven that's Better than Yours
summary: Technology Connections examines an old feature-rich microwave and shows how it uses a humidity or steam sensor and lookup data to cook food well, arguing it beats many modern ones.
why: Cited again and again in microwave and smart-appliance threads as proof that older appliances were smarter, especially for steam-sensor cooking.

quote.text: it explains how microwaves use a humidity probe to sense steam escaping from say a microwave-popcorn bag to determine when its done.
